description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called `SystemRunSettingsView` for managing system run approval settings, including agent selection, security, ask modes, and allowlist configurations. It also contains the `ExecApprovalsSettingsModel` class which manages the state and logic for these settings.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Manages the state and logic for the run approval settings, including agents, security policies, allowlist entries, and skill bins.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistEntry
classes.description: Represents an allowlist entry with pattern, last used time, command, and resolved path info.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches and updates agent list and settings for the selected agent.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of agents from configuration store.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Sets the current agent and reloads its settings.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads security and allowlist settings for a specified agent.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates security setting both locally and in persistent store.

methods.name: setAskFallback
methods.description: Updates fallback security mode for ask.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-allow for skill CLI commands.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist entry after validation.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry after validation.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a given pattern is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Fetches current skill bins for auto-allow feature.

methods.name: syncQuickMode
methods.description: Syncs the quick approval mode based on current settings.
